title: Improving the efficiency of Cr(VI) reduction and adsorption by Fe3O4 using ZSM-5 zeolite support prepared through various methods
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5808-5821
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06845A, Paper

Nichapha Senamart, Worapol Yingyuen, Waranya Obrom, Tatchapol Nanmong, Surangkhana Budsombat, Jatuporn Wittayakun, Sanchai Prayoonpokarach, Sirinuch Loiha
The study involved the synthesis of magnetite (Fe3O4) and zeolite-supported Fe3O4 (Fe/Z) using co-precipitation (COP) and hydrothermal (HYD) methods which proved effective for removing Cr(VI) from contaminated water.
